theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (K : NNReal) (H : Euclid P → Euclid P) (ψ : ℕ → Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (V Y : ℕ → Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (F : ℕ → Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (hs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ) (w : Euclid P → Euclid P), MeasurableSet M → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → μHE[n + 1] (M ∩ C) ≠ ∞) → LipschitzWith K h → Measurable H → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ K) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt (n + 1) M x (approxTangentPlane (n + 1) M x) ∧ H x ∈ approxTangentPlane (n + 1) M x ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μHE[n + 1] (M ∩ ball x r ∩ {y | ε * ‖y - x‖ < |h y - h x - inner ℝ (H x) (y - x)|}) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (n + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → (∀ j, IsOpen (V j) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (ψ j) ∧ InjOn (ψ j) (V j) ∧ (∀ y ∈ V j, Injective (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y)) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (F j) ∧ MeasurableSet (Y j) ∧ IsCompact (closure (Y j)) ∧ closure (Y j) ⊆ V j ∧ ψ j '' Y j ⊆ M ∧ (∀ y ∈ Y j, h (ψ j y) = F j y) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Y j, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt (n + 1) M (ψ j y) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (ψ i '' Y i) (ψ j '' Y j)) → μHE[n + 1] (M \ ⋃ j, ψ j '' Y j) = 0 → (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (hs k)) → (∀ k x, ‖fderiv ℝ (hs k) x‖ ≤ K) → TendstoUniformly hs h atTop → IntegrableOn w M μHE[n + 1] → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict M), w x ∈ approxTangentPlane (n + 1) M x) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in M, fderiv ℝ (hs k) x (w x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in M, inner ℝ (H x) (w x) ∂μHE[n + 1]))
